rounds.text: The business is exhibiting a powerful recent acceleration in fundamental performance, highlighted by a staggering 259% compounded sales growth and a 340% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E16, E20]. This operational momentum is directly translating into significant margin expansion, with the operating margin surging to 76% in the TTM from just 2% three years prior [E29]. Financially, the company operates with a pristine balance sheet, boasting a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.02x and being flagged as almost debt-free [E35, E47]. Furthermore, results are rapidly improving with a net profit increase of 177% year-over-year, demonstrating that the company is starting to outperform historical expectations [E45, E55]. Conceded: [E38], [E41], [E51].

The valuation is fundamentally disconnected from underlying fundamental reality, trading at an elevated P/E of 45.5x [E1] and an EV/EBITDA of 36.61x that severely outpaces the sector benchmark of 11.29x [E11]. This expensive pricing is backed by abysmal return metrics, including a multi-year ROCE of 0.7% [E12] and an ROE of 0.4% [E13], alongside a discounted cash flow intrinsic value pointing to a steep negative margin of safety of -182.5% [E42]. Operational quality is severely compromised, evidenced by negative operating cash flow of Rs -0.04 Cr and free cash flow of -12.06 Cr [E34], ballooning debtor days from 58.3 to 139 days [E52], and working capital days expanding into the thousands [E53]. Most damningly, promoters have entirely abandoned ship, reducing their holding from 44.97% to an absolute zero of 0.00% [E38]. Conceded: compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months reached 340% [E20] and operating margins expanded significantly [E29].

Conceded: [E1], [E11], [E12], [E13], [E34], [E38], [E42], [E52], and [E53]. The bear overlooks a massive inflection in operating fundamentals, driven by a 259% surge in TTM sales growth [E16] and a 340% compounded profit expansion over the trailing twelve months [E20]. This explosive acceleration has propelled operating margins to 76% in the TTM period, marking a dramatic 73 percentage point improvement from just 2% three years prior [E29]. Furthermore, recent profitability is catching up aggressively with valuation, as profit growth exceeds 1-year price growth by 381% to signal that the company is actively beginning to outperform expectations [E45]. The balance sheet remains pristine and virtually debt-free with a conservative debt-to-equity ratio of 0.02x [E35], [E47], offering a secure financial platform to support this surging operational turnaround [E62].

Conceded: [E16], [E20], [E29], and [E35]. While the bull points to a TTM sales surge of 259% [E16] and profit expansion of 340% [E20], these figures mask severe multi-year stagnation, including a 54% drop in 3-year sales growth [E15] and a 58% drop in 3-year profit growth [E19]. The touted 76% operating margin [E29] is undermined by an inconsistent yearly and quarterly trend [E30, E31] and earnings that are padded by non-operating sources such as Rs 0.74 Cr of other income [E51]. Furthermore, the company's financial health is compromised by negative operating cash flow of Rs -0.04 Cr and a free cash flow drain of Rs -12.06 Cr in Mar 2026 [E33, E34], yielding a dismal cash conversion ratio of -0.22x [E32]. Finally, the complete exit of promoters—dropping from 44.97% down to 0.00%—destroys any credibility in a long-term operational turnaround [E38].
